open-source-release.title: Open Source Release
open-source-release.description: README.md + LICENSE + CONTRIBUTING.md + SECURITY.md + .env.example + GitHub Actions CI (build+lint+test on PR) + release workflow (tag → signed APK → GitHub Release)。
acceptCriteria: README.md exists with install guide and quick start
LICENSE file exists (MIT or Apache 2.0)
CONTRIBUTING.md and SECURITY.md exist
GitHub Actions CI runs build+lint+test on PR
Release workflow produces signed APK on tag
open-source-release.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase2-utility.title: Phase 2: 真实实用性
phase2-utility.description: Prompt externalization + app skill discovery + eval regression CI。Agent 能在用户日常用的 30+ app 上工作。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done
30+ app skills generated via discovery system
Eval runs as CI gate on PRs

prompt-externalization.title: Prompt Externalization
prompt-externalization.description: System prompt 从 StandaloneAgentDef.kt 等硬编码字符串 → assets/persona/<role>/system_prompt.md。新增 PersonaRepository（接口 + asset 实现）。App skill 迭代不再需要重新编译 APK。对应 OpenClaw roadmap P3 Phase 1。是 app skill discovery 的前置条件。
acceptCriteria: System prompt loaded from assets/persona/standalone/system_prompt.md
PersonaRepository interface + AssetPersonaRepository implementation exist
AgentDef subclasses use PersonaRepository instead of inline strings
Changing asset file changes agent behavior without APK rebuild
./gradlew test passes
prompt-externalization.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

app-skill-discovery.title: App Skill Discovery 系统
app-skill-discovery.description: 建一个系统让 agent 自己探索 app 并提炼 SKILL.md（含 Safety section）。Discovery loop: 给定 target app → agent 启动 → 系统性探索 UI 路径 → 记录 a11y tree 特征、navigation pattern、pitfall → 生成 SKILL.md draft。英文市场 top 30 app 优先。需要 quality gate（跑 test task / 人工 review）。
acceptCriteria: Discovery system can generate SKILL.md for a given target app
Generated SKILL.md includes ## Safety section
At least 20 new app skills generated and reviewed
./gradlew assembleDebug passes
app-skill-discovery.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

eval-regression-ci.title: Eval 转 Regression CI
eval-regression-ci.description: AndroidWorld full set 作为 regression gate。PR 跑 eval，regression 才 fail。停止 autotune optimization loop（R58 是最后一轮主动优化）。保留 eval infra 不变。
acceptCriteria: CI workflow runs eval on PR
Eval regression detected and reported as CI failure
Eval pass/fail threshold configured based on R58 baseline
eval-regression-ci.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

phase3-daily-assistant.title: Phase 3: 日常助手
phase3-daily-assistant.description: Scheduled tasks + notification handling + OpenAI OAuth。把 Android Agent 从一次性工具变成每天都用的 assistant。
acceptCriteria: All child tasks done

scheduled-tasks.title: Scheduled Tasks
scheduled-tasks.description: Cron 式定时任务执行。用户设定 schedule + natural language instruction。AlarmManager/WorkManager 触发 → 启动 agent session → 执行 → 记录结果。UI: 任务列表、创建/编辑/删除、执行历史。
acceptCriteria: User can create a scheduled task with cron expression and instruction
Tasks execute on schedule via WorkManager/AlarmManager
Execution results recorded and viewable
Failed tasks show error and can be retried
scheduled-tasks.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

notification-handling.title: Notification Handling
notification-handling.description: NotificationListenerService 监听 → 按用户定义的规则触发 agent 响应。规则引擎：app filter + keyword filter + sender filter → trigger action。用户 explicit opt-in 每条规则。
acceptCriteria: NotificationListenerService captures notifications
User can create filter rules (app, keyword, sender)
Matching notifications trigger agent task execution
Each rule requires explicit user opt-in
notification-handling.note: Pending human review — design not yet discussed

openai-oauth.title: OpenAI OAuth Login
openai-oauth.description: 参考 OpenClaw 实现：OpenAI Codex OAuth flow。用户用 OpenAI 账号登录 → 复用已有 subscription。和手动 API key 并存。降低新用户 onboarding friction。
acceptCriteria: OAuth login flow implemented for OpenAI
User can authenticate via OpenAI account
Falls back to manual API key entry
Token refresh handled automatically
openai-oauth.note: OAuth login + CodexResponseClient implemented. Settings integration is a separate task.

sec-app-tiers-expansion.title: app_tiers.json 扩展到 100-1000 app
sec-app-tiers-expansion.description: 将 app_tiers.json 从当前 61 个 app (36 blocked + 25 normal) 扩展到覆盖世界常用 100-1000 个 app。需要设计数据获取流程: 拉取 package name + app name + category (Google Play top charts, AppBrain 等) → 用 LLM 批量评估 tier。独立设计任务。
acceptCriteria: app_tiers.json contains 100+ classified apps
Coverage includes top apps from major Play Store categories
Financial/payment/auth apps correctly classified as BLOCKED
Classification methodology documented

qa-capsule-batch2.title: QA Batch 2 — SmartCapsule state-machine tests (K1-K14)
qa-capsule-batch2.description:
Implement 14 Compose instrumented tests for the SmartCapsule state machine, following Batch 1 pattern (flat layout under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/, prefer text/contentDescription selectors, add testTag only when needed, use org.junit.Assert not kotlin built-in assert).

Test IDs per bootstrap plan (doc/todo/qa_test/final/cn/bootstrap_plan.md):
K1  Hidden_RendersNothing
K2  Running_ShowsThoughtAndTakeoverButton
K3  Running_ShowsStopButton
K4  Takeover_ShowsResumeInsteadOfTakeover
K5  WaitingForInput_ExpandsWithTextFieldAndHint
K6  WaitingForInput_SendEnabledOnlyWhenNonBlank
K7  WaitingForInput_TypingFiresOnInputChange
K8  WaitingForInput_SendClearsField
K9  WaitingForAction_ShowsInstructionAndDoneButton
K10 WaitingForApproval_ShowsFourScopeButtons
K11 Done_ShowsSuccessMessageAndAutoDismisses
K12 Error_DismissButtonFiresCallback
K13 Stop_IsStopPendingDimsButton
K14 NavigationButtons_FireCorrectEnum

Relevant source: app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/capsule/** (SmartCapsuleCompose.kt + surface/*.kt; discover CapsuleState location).

Pattern from Batch 1 (ref commits 3c4f586d, 2966ffdd, 21e34233):
- createComposeRule() + setContent
- org.junit.Assert.assertTrue/assertEquals (NEVER kotlin built-in assert)
- testTag in production only when text/contentDescription is unavailable
- For K11 auto-dismiss: compose.mainClock.autoAdvance = false + advanceTimeBy
acceptCriteria: All 14 K1-K14 tests exist as @Test methods under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/
./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.package=ai.closepaw.qa exits 0 on connected device
grep -RE "^\s*assert\(" app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/ returns no matches (no kotlin built-in assert for verdicts)
testTag additions in app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/capsule/ are minimal and justified
qa-capsule-batch2.note: 32 tests green (17 Batch 1 + 15 Batch 2). Codex review found 1 blocker (K11 not exercising real auto-dismiss) + 2 concerns (K1 weak, K8 vacuous). All fixed on top: K11 now drives CapsuleStateHolder.scheduleAutoHide, K1 broadened, K7/K8 use EditableText semantics. Fix changes landed in e2b6e212 (concurrent commit sweep — attribution noisy but code correct).

qa-settings-batch3.title: QA Batch 3 — Settings tests (S1-S12)
qa-settings-batch3.description:
Implement 12 Compose instrumented tests for the Settings surface, following the pattern from Batches 1-2. Flat layout under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/, prefer text or contentDescription, testTag only when needed, org.junit.Assert (NEVER kotlin built-in assert which is a no-op without -ea).

Test IDs per bootstrap plan (doc/todo/qa_test/final/cn/bootstrap_plan.md Batch 3):
S1  Sheet_OpensToHomePage
S2  Sheet_DismissClosesSheet
S3  Sheet_BackFromSubPageReturnsToHome
S4  Sheet_PageStateSurvivesRotation (rememberSaveable)
S5  LlmAuth_TabSwitchDoesNotCommitBackend
S6  LlmAuth_OAuthStartCommitsBackendAndMethod
S7  LlmAuth_ApiKeyProviderSwitchesModelOptions
S8  LlmAuth_IncompatibleModelAutoResetsOnMethodSwitch
S9  AgentBehavior_ProModeShowsExecutorDropdown
S10 Permissions_SessionTracesToggleShowsWarningBanner
S11 Permissions_ClearTracesShowsConfirmDialog
S12 Permissions_ClearTracesConfirmDisablesButton

Relevant source files under app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/settings/: SettingsSheet, SettingsHomePage, LlmAuthSettingsPage, AgentBehaviorSettingsPage, PermissionsAdvancedSettingsPage, SettingsModels, SettingsDropdowns, SettingsWidgets.

Pattern rules (non-negotiable):
- org.junit.Assert for verdicts, NEVER kotlin built-in assert
- Flat layout, group into a few files by theme (SettingsNavTest, SettingsLlmAuthTest, SettingsAgentBehaviorTest, SettingsPermissionsTest)
- testTag in production only when text or contentDescription is not a stable selector
- For S4 rotation: use StateRestorationTester from androidx.compose.ui.test to exercise rememberSaveable without actually rotating
- For S8 model canonicalization: call the composable with an incompatible provider/model pair and assert onModelChange fires with a valid model, OR that the dropdown shows only valid options
acceptCriteria: All 12 S1-S12 tests exist as @Test methods under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/
./gradlew connectedDebugAndroidTest -Pandroid.testInstrumentationRunnerArguments.package=ai.closepaw.qa exits 0 on connected device
grep -RE on kotlin built-in assert under app/src/androidTest/kotlin/ai/closepaw/qa/ returns no matches
testTag additions in app/src/main/kotlin/ai/closepaw/ui/settings/ are minimal and justified
